ledger.claim: This was a scheduled (advance) booking, and the rider cancelled outside the advance grace: trip_record carries scheduled_at 2026-08-10T17:55:08+08:00 and cancelled_at 2026-08-10T17:35:08+08:00 - exactly 1,200 seconds before the scheduled pickup, and therefore more than the 900-second advance grace the policy in force for this trip sets (platform_policy.advance_grace_before_scheduled_sec = 900). Under POL-NS-10(b) a cancellation made more than that window before the scheduled time is not chargeable, whatever the driver's position, and the driver's early arrival cannot shorten it. The trip was accepted at 17:10:08, well before the 900-second window opened at 17:40:08, so nothing in limb (a) displaces limb (b). Limb (f)'s chargeability for a rider's own cancellation bites only once the limb (a) or limb (b) grace has run; this cancellation precedes the advance window altogether, so POL-NS-10(b), not limb (f), governs.

Because POL-NS-10(b) makes this cancellation non-chargeable, POL-NS-10(c) directs that the fee charged on it is refunded in full with no driver compensation. The payments ledger shows cancellation_fee 4.50 SGD, total_charged 4.50 SGD, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00: the whole of the contested 4.50 SGD is still with the platform, so a full refund of the cancellation-fee line returns the entire contested amount rather than part of it.

Independently of the advance-booking grace, the baseline no-show charge of POL-NS-01 cannot stand, because limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event in the trip record and this record contains none: arrived_at is null and the event list runs driver_assigned (17:10:08) -> driver_en_route (17:10:16) -> trip_cancelled (17:35:08), with no arrival marker of any kind and no wait-timer event. Limb (a) therefore fails, and under POL-NS-01's own closing words the fee is not chargeable under that clause.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 fails on the face of the record as well. The trip was terminated by the rider with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CANCELLED and cancelled_by RIDER, which is none of the three codes limb (d) recognises (RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE, EXCESSIVE_WAIT), and no boarding event is recorded. A no-show fee cannot be built on a cancellation the rider himself made under a code the clause does not name.

The waiting period the fee is meant to buy was never served. The driver's own trace yields 0 in-geofence fixes, an accumulated in-geofence dwell of 0.0 seconds and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this STANDARD pickup - a shortfall of the full 180 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 a cancellation fee on an effective in-geofence dwell shorter than that minimum is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

The driver never arrived at the pickup point at all. Across 157 fixes spanning 17:10:08 to 17:36:08 (100% coverage, no gaps), his closest approach to the pickup pin was 13,999.99 m, his mean distance was 27,000.03 m, and his reported speeds run from 57.0 to 63.0 km/h - expressway speeds - right through the moment of cancellation at 17:35:08. Against the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius there is no qualifying in-radius fix (qualifying_fix_count 0), so POL-NS-02's arrival test is not merely unsatisfied, it is missed by roughly 14 kilometres.

The one route that could have accumulated dwell across separate in-geofence intervals - POL-NS-06(i) - is unavailable on this record. It requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, covering the pickup road and the waiting period. EV-ADVIS-02738-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT (no advisory covers Blk 55 Lengkok Bahru in this window). With limb (i) unavailable there is nothing to sum, the dwell stands at zero, and the POL-NS-06 shortfall remains the full 180 seconds.

No driver compensation is payable and no anti-farming escalation arises on this record. POL-NS-01 is not satisfied on any limb, so POL-NS-07's payout condition is never reached; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip on this driver, because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4 the clause requires, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d (90) is 0.022, below the 0.08 rate the clause requires. The check requires BOTH limbs, so neither the withholding in POL-NS-07 nor the escalation limb POL-NS-09(d) is engaged, and the disputed fee should be refunded rather than held.

There is no platform-telemetry shortcut to arrival here. The arrival marker in force for this trip is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, and the record carries no platform arrival event, no wait_timer_started and no wait_timer_expired. POL-NS-12 therefore does not apply, and the driver's arrival can only be established on the exported trace - which places him some 14 km away and moving at over 57 km/h when the trip was cancelled.

The money on this record is clean and the refund figure is not uncertain. The fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line of 4.50 SGD equals the net fee the fee_schedule.resolution_rule produces for this trip (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect arises, refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, and the evidence bundle is otherwise complete at weight 1.0. Nothing in the record supports a part-refund or a held fee: the rider is entitled to the full 4.50 SGD.

Any suggestion that the rider was not where he was supposed to be is contradicted by his own trace: the rider's device registers a stationary fix (0.0 km/h) 3.93 m from the pickup pin at 17:35:48, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 1). POL-NS-04's unanswered-message route is not itself available on this record because the chat log holds 0 messages, so limbs (a) and (b) of that clause cannot be made out; the point is only that the rider's non-appearance cannot be inferred, and the refund rests on POL-NS-10(b) and POL-NS-06 rather than on POL-NS-04.

This trip ended as a rider-initiated cancellation, not a no-show. The record closes it as CANCELLED_BY_RIDER with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CANCELLED at 17:35:08, and the ledger carries the $4.50 as a cancellation-fee line rather than a no-show charge earned by an arrival. The dispute therefore falls to be decided under POL-NS-10, the clause that governs a rider's own cancellation, and not under the arrival test of POL-NS-01.

The only grace limb (a) of POL-NS-10 creates for this rider is a cancellation within 180 seconds of the match. The match is recorded at 17:10:08 and the rider cancelled at 17:35:08, 1500 seconds later, so limb (a) affords her nothing at all on these timestamps.

On the driver's reading of POL-NS-10, limb (f) — the limb that expressly governs 'a rider's own cancellation' — is the charging rule once the grace has run, and it makes the fee chargeable at the published figure 'whether or not the driver had arrived'. Its four refund exceptions are exhaustive, and the rider's cancellation at 17:35:08 falls within none of them, so the fee stands. Limb (b)'s pre-scheduled window is part of the same charging scheme and cannot be read to empty limb (f) of its exhaustive exception list on facts where the rider was matched and the driver dispatched twenty-five minutes before she terminated.

The driver performed his side of the booking. He accepted at 17:10:08 and the trip record shows he began navigating to the pickup point 8 seconds later, at 17:10:16, and the trace then runs continuously with 157 fixes, no gaps and 100% coverage over 26.0 km. Limb (f)'s first refund exception — that the driver had not begun moving toward the pickup within the grace — is therefore not made out.

The driver was never late and no mismatch is shown. The first ETA displayed to the rider was 40 minutes (arrival about 17:50:08) and the rider cancelled at 17:35:08, before that estimate; the chat log carries no message in which the driver asked the rider to cancel, and nothing in the trip record or the chat log shows a vehicle or driver mismatch. None of limb (f)'s remaining refund exceptions is made out.

The $4.50 charged is the platform's own published figure in force for this trip — platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $4.50 for a RYDE_X booking at a STANDARD pickup — and the fare line reconciles to it, so the charge discloses no integrity defect within POL-NS-08(d) and there is no arithmetic footing on which to reduce it.

ruling.explanation:
This was an advance (scheduled) booking, and the cancellation fell outside the chargeable window. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02738) shows the booking accepted at 17:10:08 on 10 Aug 2026 for a scheduled pickup at 17:55:08, and the rider cancelled at 17:35:08 — 1,200 seconds before the scheduled time. The policy in force for this trip sets the advance cancellation grace at 900 seconds before the scheduled pickup (platform_policy.advance_grace_before_scheduled_sec), so the free-cancellation period ran up to 17:40:08. The rider cancelled more than 900 seconds before the scheduled time, and POL-NS-10(b) states that such a cancellation 'is not chargeable'. The trip was accepted at 17:10:08, well before that 900-second window opened, so POL-NS-10(b)'s proviso pulling limb (a) in from accepted_at does not apply, and the 180-second post-match grace of limb (a) is irrelevant. POL-NS-10(c) then directs that the fee charged on a cancellation made non-chargeable by limb (a) or (b) is refunded in full with no driver compensation: the payments ledger (EV-FARE-02738) shows cancellation_fee 4.50 SGD, total_charged 4.50 SGD, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole contested 4.50 SGD returns to the rider. To the driver: your reading of POL-NS-10(f) as the governing charging rule is rejected. Limb (f) charges 'a rider's own cancellation after the grace in limb (a) or (b)' — that is, one falling after the free-cancellation period has run. This cancellation was made inside the limb (b) advance grace (17:35:08, before the window opened at 17:40:08), so limb (f) is not engaged and limb (b) governs. Your remaining points are accepted as correct on the record but do not change the outcome: the driver did begin navigating 8 seconds after acceptance (17:10:16), the trace runs 157 fixes with no gaps and 100% coverage, no limb (f) refund exception is made out, and the 4.50 SGD fare line reconciles to the platform's published figure, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect arises. To the rider: your core case is right, and it is independently supported. The baseline no-show charge also fails: POL-NS-01 limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event in the trip record and there is none (arrived_at is null and the event list runs driver_assigned to driver_en_route to trip_cancelled only), and limb (d) requires termination under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, whereas the record closes with RIDER_CANCELLED. The driver's own trace places him about 14,000 m from the pickup pin and moving at 57–63 km/h at the moment of cancellation, so the 180-second free waiting period was never served (0 seconds of in-geofence dwell) and POL-NS-06 supports a full refund. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied on any limb, so POL-NS-07's payout condition is never reached, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the required 4, and 2/90 = 0.022, below the required 0.08), so POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged. Evidence quality: the ruling rests on the trip record and the fare breakdown, both carrying weight_multiplier 1.0, and no POL-NS-08 limb is engaged (no clock skew, no trace gap over 120 seconds, the chat log is internally consistent, and the fare line reconciles), so confidence is not capped below 1.0 and is stated at 0.92. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02738-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact this ruling needs (POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is not required) and it does not affect the outcome or the confidence. No clause produces a referral and the case does not escalate: confidence 0.92 is above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect of 4.50 SGD is at or below the 8.00 SGD execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is executed automatically on issue.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
